hero.title: Web applications built properly, from database schema to deployment.
hero.lead: Codepedia is a small full-stack studio in Moldova. We work with founders and business owners in Romania, Moldova and Western Europe who need senior-level execution instead of another half-finished project.

services.title: Two levels of work. Both delivered end to end.

level1.title: Websites that are simply built well
level1.lead: Presentation sites, landing pages and online stores. Written by hand, fast, indexable, editable by you. No page builder to slow the site down.

level2.lead: When the work is business logic rather than pages: roles and permissions, data modelling, integrations, automation.

services.note: Some projects are under NDA. Detailed references available on the diagnostic call.

stack.title: One stack, chosen so it stays maintainable after handover.

process.title: Four steps, fixed price per step.

about.title: A small studio with senior people on every project.
about.lead: Codepedia runs two to three projects at a time. There is no account manager and no junior for you to train. The person who discusses the scope is the person who writes the code.

contact.title: Tell us what needs to be built.
contact.lead: A short description of the problem is enough. You get a written answer within one working day, with an honest opinion on whether we are the right studio for it.
